property_summary: If a caller deposits a positive even or odd amount, the contract's stored balances for that caller increases by the deposited amount (i.e., balances[msg.sender] increments by v), so after Deposit the stored balance equals the deposited amount when starting from zero.
change_summary: Insert a conditional that only updates balances when msg.value is an even number, otherwise skip the update (so some deposits don't change balances).
